comment: Reviewed license exceptions for tools/sbomcheck (SRS FR-12.1). Each entry accepts one identifier for one package; the release workflow refuses any other identifier that is not OSI-approved or public domain. LicenseRef identifiers are syft's SHA-256 of a license-like file it could not match to an SPDX license.

reviews.reason: the module's LICENSE licenses code under Apache-2.0 (MIT for contributions not yet relicensed) and documentation under CC-BY-4.0; the release binaries link only its Go packages, not its documentation

hash of mcp-spec/2026-07-28/LICENSE, the license of the vendored MCP specification text kept in the source tree as reference material; no binary contains it. The Gateway itself is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE)
hash of internal/approval/notice_test.go, a Go test of desktop notifications that syft takes for a NOTICE file by its name; it holds no license text and is not compiled into the release binaries
hash of the module's NOTICE.txt, the attribution notice that Apache-2.0 section 4(d) requires, not a license; the module is Apache-2.0 with BSD-3-Clause parts (LICENSE.txt)
